title: Judge Gift Cards 2006: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "She is a theme of honor and renown, . . . Whose present courage may beat down our foes." —William Shakespeare, *Troilus and Cressida*
"Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."
Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.
"The tyrannous and bloody deed is done, The most arch deed of piteous massacre That ever yet this land was guilty of." —William Shakespeare, *Richard III*
